title: Jobs
description: Active Job throughput, failures, duration and queue time.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ServiceName
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ServiceName

panels.title: Jobs performed by class

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['messaging.active_job.job.class'] AS job, sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'messaging.process.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND Attributes['messaging.system.name'] = 'active_job'
GROUP BY time, job
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Jobs performed per second, from messaging.process.duration.

panels.title: Failed jobs by error

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['error.type'] AS error, sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'messaging.process.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND Attributes['messaging.system.name'] = 'active_job' AND Attributes['error.type'] != ''
GROUP BY time, error
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Jobs whose perform raised, per second, by error.type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, job, q[1] AS p95
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['messaging.active_job.job.class'] AS job,
         quantilesExactWeighted(0.95)(pow(2, (PositiveOffset + i - 1 + 0.5) * pow(2, -Scale)), c) AS q
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
  ARRAY JOIN PositiveBucketCounts AS c, arrayEnumerate(PositiveBucketCounts) AS i
  WHERE MetricName = 'messaging.process.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND c > 0 AND Attributes['messaging.system.name'] = 'active_job'
  GROUP BY time, job
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Queue time p95 by queue

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, queue, q[1] AS p95
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['messaging.destination.name'] AS queue,
         quantilesExactWeighted(0.95)(pow(2, (PositiveOffset + i - 1 + 0.5) * pow(2, -Scale)), c) AS q
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
  ARRAY JOIN PositiveBucketCounts AS c, arrayEnumerate(PositiveBucketCounts) AS i
  WHERE MetricName = 'active_job.queue.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND c > 0
  GROUP BY time, queue
)
ORDER BY time

panels.description: How long jobs waited between being due and starting, from active_job.queue.duration.

panels.title: Jobs enqueued by class

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['messaging.active_job.job.class'] AS job, sum(Value) / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'messaging.client.sent.messages' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, job
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Jobs enqueued per second, from the messaging.client.sent.messages counter.

panels.title: Retries and discards

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, MetricName AS metric, sum(Value) / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName IN ('active_job.retries', 'active_job.exhausted_retries', 'active_job.discards')
  AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time

panels.description: active_job.retries, active_job.exhausted_retries and active_job.discards per second.
